swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Freshwater is a limited and precious resource, even though water covers most of the Earth's surface. Reason (R): Most of the water on Earth is saline seawater, and only a small, often hard-to-access fraction is freshwater. Choose the correct option.

add.q: Assertion (A): Freshwater is abundant and freely available everywhere on Earth, since water covers most of the Earth's surface. Reason (R): Most of the water on Earth is saline seawater, and only a small, often hard-to-access fraction is freshwater. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is false, R is true
o: A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
